api:
<Waffle data={mix} name={|s: &Share| s.name} value={|s: &Share| s.value} />
PropTypeDefault
dataas aboverequired
nameFn(&T) -> &strrequired
valueFn(&T) -> f64required
rows, columnsusize10, 10
gapf32: the space between squares, as a share of a square0.12
legendLegendshown
tooltip, class

Each item gets a share of the rows × columns squares, filled in order, row by row. Shares are rounded by the largest-remainder method, so the squares always add up to the full grid.

examples.title: Energy mix
examples.description: 100 squares, one per percent, filled in order.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn energy() {
    let data = use_signal(mix(&[
        ("Solar", 31.),
        ("Wind", 24.),
        ("Hydro", 17.),
        ("Gas", 19.),
        ("Coal", 9.),
    ]));
    rsx! { <Waffle data={data} name={|s: &Share| s.name} value={|s: &Share| s.value} class="h-72" /> }
}
